name: Berggasthaus Ederkanzel
kurzbeschreibung: **Mountain Inn Ederkanzel** nestled in the heart of **Mittenwald**, invites you to experience the pure charm of the **Tirol** Alps. Enjoy breathtaking views of the **Karwendel** and **Zugspitze** while savoring hearty **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh mountain dishes. Cozy up by the fireplace or take a refreshing break on the sunny terrace. A perfect stop for hikers, families, and anyone seeking relaxation in nature’s embrace. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this rustic retreat promises warmth, hospitality, and unforgettable moments in the great outdoors.
